title: Invisible to Recruiters? Why Your Resume Isn’t Getting Seen (Get Seen Series)
description:
If you feel invisible in this job market, you’re not alone — and it’s not your skills. Most recruiters scan resumes in about 6 seconds, and what’s happening at the top of your resume often decides everything.

That’s why I just launched my Get Seen series.

In this series, I break down:

What recruiters look for first

What actually belongs at the top of your resume

How to write summaries and bullets that get noticed

Simple AI hacks (used the right way)

Bonus downloadable cheat sheets after each long video

This series is about getting you seen, interviewed, and hired — starting with the first few seconds that matter most.

 Watch the full series on my channel @kirchnercareers

 Subscribe for practical, no-fluff job search guidance
 
Want step-by-step help? My Get Seen Resume & Job Search Strategy Guide walks you through this process in detail. Link Below
